source_lineage.excerpt:
If the above recommendations do not help, contact IBM support with the following information:  * Environment details including the application server, JDK, database and operating system. 
 * RTS server logs, including FFDC logs if working with WebSphere Application Server. 
 * The typical behavior of RTS users: Are they mostly viewing or editing? Is there a lot of ruleset generation going on simultaneously while editing? 
 * The typical load on RTS, including the number of simultaneous users and number of rulesets being generated

* Reduce the memory footprint of the ruleset by setting the ruleset property ruleset.bom.enabled [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.dserver.res%2FContent%2FBusiness_Rules%2F_pubskel%2FInfocenter_Primary%2Fps_DS_RES_Console_OH1654.html] to "false [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.dserver.res%2FContent%2FBusiness_Rules%2F_pubskel%2FInfocenter_Primary%2Fps_DS_Rule_Execution_Server1564.html]" to remove support for BOM based serialization. This property is set to "true" by default when extracting rulesets from Rule Team Server (RTS) and Decision Center, and needs to be explicitly set to "false" in order to deactivate it. (You should set it to "true" if you need to generate an Excel report from a Test Suite/Simulation in RTS or Decision Center.)

* Accelerate ruleset generation by turning on Automatic Build by checking Project > Edit Project options > Build automatically. This will enable RTS to generate the IRL as soon as a rule is saved. If this is turned off, the first time a ruleset is generated, RTS will generate the IRL of the entire ruleset, which can be a performance bottleneck. However this can slow down the time taken to save a rule after editing it.

 * Disable the flag to check the ruleset archive by unchecking Project > Edit project options > Check the ruleset archive. By default, the ruleset archive is checked for syntax errors. You should turn this off only in testing environments to improve performance. If deploying to a production environment it is recommended that the ruleset check is activated. 

 * Reduce the size of the RuleApps by generating multiple smaller rulesets from a rule project.

 * Turn off baseline generation upon RuleApp extraction, if it is not needed.

 * If the ruleset extraction times out, increase the timeout value in the web.xml file of the RTS EAR, and redeploy the EAR. If working with Oracle Weblogic Application Server, you might have to increase the StuckThreadMaxTime value. The following document addresses ruleset extraction timeout in greater detail: Timeout on RuleApp deployment from Rule Team Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21456181].

ABSTRACT
 The following list includes frequently asked questions (FAQ) about WebSphere ILOG Rule Team Server to help you troubleshoot problems and enhance your use of the product.

WebSphere Operational Decision Management has various modules whose performance can be improved. The following documents specify how to improve the performance when working with each module:


 * Improve Performance of Rule Designer [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21589514] 
 * Improve Performance of Decision Center [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21584855] 
 * Design Events for performance in Event Designer [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.wbe.appdev.doc%2Fdoc%2Fdesigningforperformance.html] 
 * Improve Performance of rule execution and Rule Execution Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21589513] 
 * Improve Performance of Decision Validation Services and Decision Warehouse [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21588859]

* Improve ruleset parsing performance while debugging [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21444782]. 
 * Improve performance when synchronizing [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21425548] with WODM Decision Center or Rule Team Server (RTS). 
 * Improve performance when conducting Decision Validation Services (DVS) tests [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21588859]. 
 * Improve performance while migrating a rule project [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21504807] to a newer version of the product. 
 * Run Rule Studio with 64-bit Java SDK [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21427022] or Rule Designer with 64-bit Java SDK [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/topic/com.ibm.decisions/pdf/wodm_installing.pdf], to help building large projects if memory runs scarce.

If the above recommendations do not help, contact IBM support with the following information:  * Environment details including the application server, JDK, database and operating system. 
 * RTS server logs, including FFDC logs if working with WebSphere Application Server. 
 * The typical behavior of RTS users: Are they mostly viewing or editing? Is there a lot of ruleset generation going on simultaneously while editing? 
 * The typical load on RTS, including the number of simultaneous users and number of rulesets being generated

* Reduce the memory footprint of the ruleset by setting the ruleset property ruleset.bom.enabled [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.dserver.res%2FContent%2FBusiness_Rules%2F_pubskel%2FInfocenter_Primary%2Fps_DS_RES_Console_OH1654.html] to "false [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.dserver.res%2FContent%2FBusiness_Rules%2F_pubskel%2FInfocenter_Primary%2Fps_DS_Rule_Execution_Server1564.html]" to remove support for BOM based serialization. This property is set to "true" by default when extracting rulesets from Rule Team Server (RTS) and Decision Center, and needs to be explicitly set to "false" in order to deactivate it. (You should set it to "true" if you need to generate an Excel report from a Test Suite/Simulation in RTS or Decision Center.)

* Accelerate ruleset generation by turning on Automatic Build by checking Project > Edit Project options > Build automatically. This will enable RTS to generate the IRL as soon as a rule is saved. If this is turned off, the first time a ruleset is generated, RTS will generate the IRL of the entire ruleset, which can be a performance bottleneck. However this can slow down the time taken to save a rule after editing it.

 * Disable the flag to check the ruleset archive by unchecking Project > Edit project options > Check the ruleset archive. By default, the ruleset archive is checked for syntax errors. You should turn this off only in testing environments to improve performance. If deploying to a production environment it is recommended that the ruleset check is activated. 

 * Reduce the size of the RuleApps by generating multiple smaller rulesets from a rule project.

 * Turn off baseline generation upon RuleApp extraction, if it is not needed.

 * If the ruleset extraction times out, increase the timeout value in the web.xml file of the RTS EAR, and redeploy the EAR. If working with Oracle Weblogic Application Server, you might have to increase the StuckThreadMaxTime value. The following document addresses ruleset extraction timeout in greater detail: Timeout on RuleApp deployment from Rule Team Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21456181].

ABSTRACT
 The following list includes frequently asked questions (FAQ) about WebSphere ILOG Rule Team Server to help you troubleshoot problems and enhance your use of the product.

WebSphere Operational Decision Management has various modules whose performance can be improved. The following documents specify how to improve the performance when working with each module:


 * Improve Performance of Rule Designer [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21589514] 
 * Improve Performance of Decision Center [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21584855] 
 * Design Events for performance in Event Designer [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.wbe.appdev.doc%2Fdoc%2Fdesigningforperformance.html] 
 * Improve Performance of rule execution and Rule Execution Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21589513] 
 * Improve Performance of Decision Validation Services and Decision Warehouse [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21588859]

* Improve ruleset parsing performance while debugging [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21444782]. 
 * Improve performance when synchronizing [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21425548] with WODM Decision Center or Rule Team Server (RTS). 
 * Improve performance when conducting Decision Validation Services (DVS) tests [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21588859]. 
 * Improve performance while migrating a rule project [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21504807] to a newer version of the product. 
 * Run Rule Studio with 64-bit Java SDK [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21427022] or Rule Designer with 64-bit Java SDK [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v7r5/topic/com.ibm.decisions/pdf/wodm_installing.pdf], to help building large projects if memory runs scarce.
